script: Spread and total were not saved for ATL@GB, so this script is form-only from weeks 1-2. Atlanta has been a Bijan Robinson offense (37 carries, 155 rush yards, 14 targets, 99 receiving yards) while Michael Penix Jr. has been negative on every dropback split (-0.35 EPA vs blitz, n=22; -0.80 with no blitz). Green Bay has thrown, not run: Christian Watson 19 targets for 188 yards and Matthew Golden 18 for 153, against Marshawn Lloyd's 19 carries for 57 yards (3.0 YPC). Green Bay's defense has allowed 3.05 YPC and only 2 passes of 20+ on 72 attempts, so form says Green Bay passes into an Atlanta defense that has already allowed 8 explosives on 81 attempts, and Atlanta's run game runs into that 3.05 YPC wall.
who_goes_off: Christian Watson should go off: 188 yards and 213 air yards on 19 targets, and Atlanta has allowed 8 gains of 20+ on 81 attempts while blitzing only 21%, the look where Jordan Love is +0.16 EPA/dropback instead of -0.24. Tucker Kraft (9 targets, 80 yards, 92 air yards) is the name that fits Atlanta's middle (14.12 YPA on 8 attempts), but his 40-yard pace sits under a 46.5 number, so he is not the wager. Atlanta's portable production is Bijan Robinson as a receiver (99 yards, -18 air yards on 14 targets), not his 4.2 YPC rushing into a Green Bay defense that has allowed 3 runs of 10+.
weak_spot: Green Bay has allowed 9.75 YPA in the middle on 8 attempts versus 5.67 on 21 left throws and 5.74 on 35 right throws, and the run defense is a strength at 3.05 YPC, so Atlanta's real matchup is the middle and underneath — linebackers, nickel, safeties — which is Bijan Robinson's -18 air-yard profile, not Drake London (45 air yards on 9 targets) or Jahan Dotson (100 air yards on 7 targets) outside. Atlanta's hole is larger: 14.12 YPA on 8 middle attempts versus 5.14 left (36 att) and 6.36 right (33 att), plus 8 explosives on 81 attempts, which is the Jordan Love-to-Christian Watson and Tucker Kraft window, not Marshawn Lloyd (3.0 YPC) into a 3.41 YPC Atlanta run defense.
injury_fallout: No injury report was saved for ATL@GB, so no injury fallout is priced. Roles are the week 1-2 counts only: Bijan Robinson 37 carries and 155 yards to Brian Robinson's 20 and 82, Marshawn Lloyd 19 carries for 57 ahead of Chris Brooks (11 for 40) and Kaleb Johnson (8 for 32), and targets piled on Christian Watson (19) and Matthew Golden (18) rather than Jayden Reed (8 for 24) or Skyy Moore (4 for 6).
qb_vs_blitz: Michael Penix Jr. is worse when Green Bay does not blitz (-0.80 EPA/dropback) than when they do (-0.35, n=22), and Green Bay has blitzed 34%, so the coverage snaps — not the extra rusher — are what have buried him and capped Drake London at 80 yards on 9 targets. Jordan Love is the reverse: -0.24 EPA vs blitz (n=46) and +0.16 with no blitz, and Atlanta blitzes only 21%, so most of his dropbacks land in the split that produced Christian Watson's 213 air yards and Matthew Golden's 217, not a scramble game (1 carry, 0 yards).

picks.why: Green Bay has allowed 3.05 YPC and only 3 runs of 10+ yards in two games. Bijan Robinson's 155 yards came on 37 carries (4.2 YPC, about 18.5 carries and 77.5 rush yards per game); at 3.05 YPC that same carry rate is about 56 rush yards, and even 20 carries at 3.5 YPC is 70, still under 78.5, with almost no long-run salvage against a defense that has allowed 3 runs of 10+.

Christian Watson has 188 receiving yards and 213 air yards on 19 targets through two games, a 94-yard pace against a 71.5 line, so he can drop about 20 yards off that pace and still clear. Atlanta has allowed 8 passes of 20+ on 81 attempts and blitzes just 21%, and Jordan Love is +0.16 EPA/dropback when not blitzed versus -0.24 when blitzed, which is the environment that generated those 213 air yards.
